headline: Balu Forge submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Routine shareholder resolutions passed at Balu Forge
summary: Balu Forge Industries Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Routine shareholder resolutions were processed during the meeting. The submission ensures regulatory compliance with the stock exchange. Indian retail investors see no direct financial impact from this procedural filing.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance update with no direct impact on stock price

headline: Ten microcap stocks see sharp declines of up to 32% in one month
summary: Ten microcap companies listed on Indian exchanges have experienced significant price corrections, with some stocks falling by as much as 32% over the past 30 days. This trend highlights the heightened volatility and liquidity risks inherent in the microcap segment. Retail investors often face substantial capital erosion during such rapid market pullbacks. These declines serve as a reminder of the importance of portfolio diversification and risk management when dealing with smaller, less liquid stocks.
why_it_matters: High-risk microcap holdings can erode portfolio value rapidly during market corrections.
